item.title: Earthquake in Freedonia kills at least 120, officials say
item.description: Rescuers are digging through rubble in Alderport after a 7.2 magnitude quake. The government has declared a state of emergency.

item.title: Senate passes bipartisan infrastructure bill 68-30
item.description: The Senate passed a bipartisan infrastructure package on Saturday. The bill now goes to the House, where its prospects are uncertain.

item.title: Fed cuts rates for first time this year
item.description: The Federal Reserve announced a quarter-point cut, saying labor market risks had increased.
